identity.title: Why Post-starburst Galaxies Are Now Quiescent

paper_type_evidence.quote: Here we present an ALMA search for the denser gas traced by HCN (1–0) and HCO$^+$ (1–0) in two CO-luminous, quiescent post-starburst galaxies.

question.value: Do CO-luminous but quiescent post-starburst galaxies contain dense gas (HCN, HCO+), and does a lack of dense gas explain their low star formation rates?

evidence.quote: These observations raise the question of why these galaxies have such low star formation rates.
